criteria.requirement: Implement cattrs.strategies.strict.configure_strict_primitives(converter, *, allow_int_float=False, finite_float=True). Opt in exact bool/int/float/str/bytes input types without coercion, reject bool as int and primitive subclasses, explicitly control int-to-float and nonfinite float policy. Apply through actual registered hooks so nested containers/records retain cattrs validation paths. Keep unconfigured converters, unstructure behavior and later user-hook overrides intact.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
